skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts, approaches, and economic principles in studying and solving the dialectical relationship between economic development and environmental protection.
Remember and understand basic methods and models in environmental economics.
Understand tools and policies built on economic bases for environmental management.
Understand approaches and methods for evaluating the economic value of resources and environment.
Apply knowledge from the course to analyze economic contents in practical environmental management.
Develop discussion skills and explain analysis contents about environmental economics.
Develop independent learning and working skills.
Develop teamwork skills and responsibility for choosing topics and solving basic problems of environmental economics in practical management.
